subject: SIG questionnaire — final artifacts and security binder request
message_1_body:
Hi Diego,

Thanks again for the demo this morning. Our security team has a couple of follow-ups before we can move to procurement. Attached is the SIG questionnaire — we flagged a few sections where we need clearer artifact references (data residency, key management, and penetration testing cadence).

Can you provide: 
- SOC 2 Type II report (most recent)
- Executive summary of last pen test and remediation status
- ISO/standards statements (if available)
- A brief security overview deck for our exec review (3–5 slides)

We’d like to have these by end of week if possible. I’ve included procurement on copy for timeline alignment.

Best,
Dana
Dana Lee
Head of Security Operations
HealthScope Medical

Attachments: SIG_questionnaire_answers_v1.xlsx
message_2_body:
Hi Dana — thanks for the note and the questionnaire. We can get you everything you asked for. Quick plan: 

1) I will assemble the SOC 2 Type II report and the pen-test summary by EOD Thursday. Karthik will validate redaction for any customer-identifying info.
2) Marissa will put together a concise security overview deck (4 slides) focused on architecture, data flows, and key controls.
3) ISO statement and cert references: we are working with our compliance team to pull the latest statements; we expect those by Friday.

A couple of clarifying asks from our side so we deliver precisely what you need: 
- Is the SOC 2 report acceptable as a vendor-only copy (we can provide a redacted PDF and a secure download link)?
- For pen test: do you need the full report or just a one-page executive summary and the remediation tracker?

I’ll upload artifacts to a secure share and send a DocuSign link if signature/NDAs are required.

Thanks —
Diego Fernandez
Head of Sales Engineering
Redwood Inference

message_3_body:
Diego — appreciate the fast turnaround. A redacted SOC 2 will be fine for now; we will request an unredacted view later during procurement if needed. For the pen test, the one-page exec summary + remediation tracker is perfect.

Also: if you can include a sentence about your key management (KMS/HSM) integrations and where encryption in transit and at rest are applied, that will help our legal/security reviewers.

Thanks,
Dana

- Slide 2 (KMS/HSM) looks good; can you add which cloud KMS provider is used for customer key storage?
- There is an open item in the SIG spreadsheet (row 47) about data retention for logs — our compliance team will follow up with a specific ask.

Procurement confirms we can proceed to the next internal review once the small clarifications are added. I’ll ping you if we need an unredacted SOC 2 later.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Best,

HealthScope Medical
